text: Stand up right now. 10 deep breaths, shoulders back, chin up. Change your body, change your state.
Drink a full glass of water, then do 20 squats.
Say your main goal out loud, with energy, three times.
Write down the ONE thing you've been avoiding. Just one sentence.
Put the phone down and move as energetically as you can for one full minute.
Splash cold water on your face and say out loud: "I'm doing this."
Do the thing you've been avoiding for just 5 minutes. Set a timer. Start now.
Send the message you've been putting off.
Say hello to a stranger and ask them one real question.
Do as many push-ups as you can. Remember the number and beat it next time.
Give someone a sincere compliment, in person or by message.
Fix one small thing that has been bugging you, and finish it.
24-hour experiment: pick one new action tied to your goal and do it once before tonight.
Take a cold shower: at least 60 seconds of cold at the end.
Ask for something you'd normally not ask for: a favor, a discount, a chance.
Do your hardest task of the day first, before messages or scrolling.
Call someone you've been meaning to call. A real call, no texting.
Do 20 minutes of walking or training right now, with no phone and no music.
RPM: write your Result (what do you want?), your Purpose (why must it happen?) and your Massive Action (what will you do today?). Then do the first step now.
Do the one thing tied to your goal that scares you most. Take the first action in the next 10 minutes.
Make the pitch, post or ask you've been postponing. Send it now.
Book it: put a date and time on the big step (call, meeting, plan, sign-up) today.
Offer to help or teach someone something you know. Reach out today.
Tell one person your goal and the date you'll hit the next milestone.
